values.note: City of Harbor Beach 2026 camping fees (one rate, no resident/non-resident split): RV/trailer under 30 ft $45, over 30 ft $46 ($50/$51 on holidays), rates including water, electric and sewer; pop-up or tent $36, rustic $29. Weekly $260/$270, monthly $660/$710, 6-month seasonal $2,400/$2,500. Cable $3/day on some sites; dump station $10. Prepaid holiday weekends: 3 nights Memorial Day and Labor Day, 2 nights July 4th, Maritime Festival and Halloween weekends.

fees.source: https://www.harborbeach.com/s/North-Park-Rates-2026.pdf ('2026 CAMPING FEES': 'RV/Trailer under 30’ $45 $50', 'RV/Trailer over 30’ $46 $51', 'Reservation Fee: $8', 'The above rates include water, electric and sewer except for the rustic sites', 'Prepaid Holiday & Festival Weekends'), read 2026-10-22

An additional 24 sites around the baseball fields are being added and should be available mid-summer 2026') + https://www.harborbeach.com/s/North-Park-Campground-Map-2025.pdf (legend 'S Reserved Seasonal'), read 2026-10-22. values.note: Reservations by phone to the campground (989-479-9554) from January 1; full payment plus the $8 reservation fee by credit card when booking. Sites are assigned by staff when the reservation is paid; specific sites can't be guaranteed. Holiday and festival weekends are sold prepaid as a block: 3 nights for Memorial Day and Labor Day, 2 nights for July 4th, Maritime Festival and Halloween weekends.

booking.source: https://www.harborbeach.com/s/North-Park-Campground-Rules-whd2.pdf ('Reservations may be made at North Park Campground by calling 989-479-9554'; 'The reservation fee ($8.00) and full payment is due at the time the reservation with credit card'; 'Campsites will be assigned, by park staff, at the time the reservation is paid') + rates PDF ('Reservations for Camping will be accepted on or after January 1, 2026'), read 2026-10-22 + rates PDF ('Prepaid Holiday & Festival Weekends 3 night holiday weekend: Memorial Day, Labor Day 2 night Holiday weekend: 4th of July, Maritime Festival and Halloween Weekends')

note: City of Harbor Beach municipal park (city-owned since 1903) on 40 acres at the north end of town, across N. Huron Ave (M-25) from Lake Huron; full-hookup modern sites, rustic sites in the woods, tent and group camping, nature trail, ball fields. Sites reported tightly spaced. --Claude
